flows.name: SAVE10 price and tax integrity
flows.objective: Open the CartLab app. Add one 'Arc Wireless Headphones' ($79.00) and one 'Field Notes' ($24.00) to the cart. Apply coupon SAVE10. Verify the cart shows subtotal $103.00, discount -$10.30, shipping FREE, tax $7.42, and total $100.12. Report failure if any amount differs.

flows.name: Guest checkout confirmation
flows.objective: Open CartLab. Add one 'Arc Wireless Headphones' to cart. Open checkout. Enter a guest name 'Kane Guard', email 'kane@example.com', and address '42 Test Lane'. Complete checkout. Verify an order-confirmation view appears with the purchaser name and a total of $92.31 (79.00 + 6.99 shipping + 6.32 tax).

flows.name: Invalid coupon is non-destructive
flows.objective: Open CartLab. Add one 'Field Notes' to cart. Note the total. Try coupon BADCODE. Verify a visible error message says coupon is invalid, and that the displayed order total stays unchanged at $32.91.
